author: warman2426
quote: GTA in name only, overwhelmingly boring. they took 13 years and over a billion dollars to make sims with nice visuals and some gun fights. the visuals are 10/10, the story is 3/10, it has some nice characters but 80 percent of them don't hold up to the 80 dollar price point. it's just a bad game. it seems like the only good triple A games come from Asia nowadays.  extremely disappointed, but I expected as much when I saw the photo of devs. GTA6 is what you get when you put a bunch of woman, and gay bottoms at the helm of one of the biggest games of all time.
